representativeProfile.interpretation: Direct codec and transaction timings overlap; scoped modes exclude outer admission and target load, while currentSnapshots may first demand sibling graphs. Do not add these categories or extrapolate a whole-journey speedup.
representativeProfile.surfaceInterpretation: Cold Planner admission validates all three new SQL payloads. Warm Planner needs only its own fresh graph; transactionAll is the unchanged eager materialization control on the same Finance state. Both retain fresh SQL observations. Their timing samples are separate from the four original modes.
representativeProfile.disclosure: Existing real Finance/C08/SQLite fixture with synthetic source grants. No short result closes FIN-IND-005; original journey budgets and assertions remain unchanged.

realConsumerProfile.interpretation: Ancestry follows real store calls across awaits. Surface labels name requested transaction surfaces; all means transactionAll. Timings are inclusive and may overlap. JSON sizes count UTF-16 code units; payloads are never retained by the observer. Counts classify observed work, not expected product behavior.
realConsumerProfile.disclosure: Unchanged real Finance/C08/SQLite fixture and original omitted.evaluate preparation, with synthetic grants. The confirmed operation is issuer.resolve plus witness 15000 only. This does not rerun confirmed sensitivity, witness 15001, replay, restart or access and cannot close FIN-IND-005.

quantitativeConclusion.scope: Same unchanged probe/fixture and financial preparation, identical measured sizes/counts/assertions and callback workload across S3/S4. Each run proves its SQL bytes unchanged within the measured subflow. No cross-run whole-payload digest equality is claimed because payload digests were not logged. The within-S4 Planner versus transactionAll control uses exactly the same payloads. Count reduction is not a whole-journey or cross-run timing speedup; unchanged nested tagged work is the control.
